name: Vermilion Veera Raihonen
original_name: ヴァーミリオン・ヴェーラ・ライホネン
source:
She is called Million for short. She is a beautiful doll-like girl with long blonde hair and is over 1000 years old.
She is one of the most XX ancient vampire species in existence and wields more magic than a magic sword with ease.
